scope: Two exact concurrency groups only, read-only; no repository-wide queue enumeration or mutation.

expressionSources.header:
name: Publish GitHub Pages from main

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Deployment is separate from pull-request admission. Let an active publication
# finish so rapid main merges cannot starve Pages; GitHub retains only the newest
# pending run, which publishes after the active one.
concurrency:
  group: pages-production
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # GitHub Pages has a published-site capacity limit. This guards deployment
  # capacity only; it is never a required pull-request check. GitHub Pages
  # permits published sites up to 1 GB; retain a 20 MB deployment margin.
  MAX_PUBLISHED_BYTES: 980000000

name: Fastline exact-head auto-merge

on:
  workflow_run:
    # Reconcile when any PR validation workflow completes, including a failure
    # that must disarm an earlier decision. The controller also waits for every
    # non-waived exact-head check already registered on the commit.
    workflows:
      - Validate source for continuous main
      - Appearance preview
      - Industrial feature verification
      - Company edition candidates
      - Assemble full-test release evidence
      - Community hosted acceptance
      - Community MinIO recovery
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types:
      [
        opened,
        reopened,
        synchronize,
        edited,
        labeled,
        unlabeled,
        milestoned,
        demilestoned,
        ready_for_review,
        converted_to_draft,
      ]
  pull_request_review:
    branches: [main]
    types: [submitted, dismissed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  checks: read
  actions: write

concurrency:
  group: fastline-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number || github.run_id }}
  # Metadata changes are cheap and read current state. Serializing them avoids
  # cancelled controller checks poisoning GitHub's merge-state rollup.
  cancel-in-progress: false

derivation.pages: Literal pages-production from the actual publisher workflow.
derivation.fastline: Literal fastline-merge- prefix plus actual pull_request.number1619 from the selected new PR event; API returns old and new members. The old workflow_run event payload was not guessed from outer run.pull_requests[].
